mapper.select: select p.plugin_name, p.param_name, p.param_desc, p.data_type, p.data_range, p.param_def_value, p.is_required from ww_plugin_parameter p where p.plugin_name = #{pluginName}
mapper.delete: delete from ww_parameter where job_id in (select j.job_id from ww_job j where j.product = #{product})
mapper.select: select c.job_id, pd.data_type, p.value from ww_parameter p left join ww_cron c on p.job_id = c.job_id and p.source_id = c.job_id left join ww_plugin_parameter pd on c.plugin = pd.plugin_name and p.name = pd.param_name where c.job_id is not null and pd.data_type in ('JOB', 'JOBS') and (c.product is null or c.product = #{product})
